تعتزموا (form VIII)
# تَعْتَزِمُوا (taʕtazimū) /taʕ.ta.zi.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
# تُعْتَزَمُوا (tuʕtazamū) /tuʕ.ta.za.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِعْتَزَمَ (iʕtazama)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
